indexApprovalNote: Every Terravion project is statutorily approved before launch, gated before handover, and planned around long-term living — not short-term selling.

amenitiesPage.intro: A plot is a beginning; a community is what surrounds it. This is the complete amenity register for each Terravion community — no renders of things that don't exist, just what is built or contractually committed.
amenitiesPage.clubhouseBody: 25,000 sq. ft. at the heart of Sanctuary: banquet hall, restaurant and café, pool complex, two indoor badminton courts, gymnasium, games lounge, business centre with co-working, and three guest suites. It opens with the community — not years after it.

indexIntro: Two approved communities on the Shankarpally belt, and a third registering interest. Each one is sold with its sanctioned layout plan attached.

detail.enquireBody: Ask for the sanctioned plan, the price list, or a drive out to the site. All three are available without obligation.
